name: us-market-research-system
description: Henren framework gauges + Serenity gate, over a canonical calculation engine. Research tooling only: no buy/sell signals, no price targets, no position sizing, no composite score.

scripts.render: node .claude/skills/us-market-brief/scripts/render-dashboard.mjs data/gauges.json data/snapshot.json data/holdings.json data/test-report.json > reports/us-market-dashboard.html
scripts.build: npm run gauges && npm run holdings && npm run render && npm run tests && npm run render && npm test

_build_note: The dashboard drifted three versions behind the engine because regeneration was a sequence of remembered commands rather than one target. `npm run build` is that target.
_build_order_note: render runs twice on purpose. The integrity tests compare the RENDERED page against the engine's JSON, so they have to run after a render or they are grading the previous run's artifact; the test report they produce then has to reach the page, which needs a second render. The second pass adds only the test-report section and touches no number, and the closing `npm test` is the real gate — it runs against the exact file that gets committed.
